name: persian-rtl
description: Right-to-left layout for Persian text in Claude Code's transcript (messages, command output, tool calls and results), correct in terminals such as Konsole that cannot do it themselves; optionally asks the model for English progress notes

englishProgressNotes.title: Progress notes in English
englishProgressNotes.description: Ask the model to write the text between tool calls in English when you write to it in Persian, Arabic, Hebrew or Urdu. Claude Code shows that text as a server-written summary, drawn left to right where a plugin cannot reach it: English reads correctly there, Persian does not. Turn off to leave the model's language alone.
